subject: proj
title: (R)PROJ.------T.C.IMP.
description: Diagram in PCC-26. (R)PROJ — the reality of projection — is crossed with T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). FUND-DYN (fundamental dynamics) and PROJ both → TRS (transition) → T-C-IMP (the crossing) → IF-SPT (infra-spirituality) → RT-DY (reality dynamics) → PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). C-CONT (composite continuance) → EXT-DYM (extended dynamics) → PROJ — meaning composite continuance feeds the reality of projection through extended dynamics. A separate sub-chain: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) → A-PR (all-purpose) → COS-P (cosmic particulars) and A-PR → PHY-U-P (physical universe particular). Structural argument: real projection's relationship to time-continuum implications requires a chain through transition, with both fundamental dynamics and projection itself producing transition. Time-continuum implications then chains through *infra-spirituality* (Braxton's term for the spiritual layer beneath surface practice) into reality dynamics into progressional continuance. Composite continuance feeds projection from a parallel direction via extended dynamics. The vibrational-dynamics → all-purpose → cosmic-particulars/physical-universe-particular sub-chain runs separately. The diagram thus diagrams a key Braxton claim about transition (PCC-26): real transition requires infra-spirituality as the necessary intermediate between time-continuum implications and reality dynamics — meaning surface practice without an infra-spiritual layer cannot produce real progressional continuance no matter how the projection is constituted.
